//: Only what the emulator and the rules deploy need. The app itself is Cloud Run, not Firebase Hosting — see infra/deploy-web.sh.

storage.//: Evidence media, avatars and uploaded paper forms. There were no storage rules at all until 2026-08-20, while storageBucket was already configured — the default posture must not be discovered on the day the first photograph is uploaded.
storage.//bucket: NAMED, because this project has no default bucket. Firebase Storage was never 'Get Started'-ed here; the bucket is the one bootstrap.sh makes, ${PROJECT}-evidence. Without this line `firebase deploy --only storage` looks for the default, does not find it, and fails with 'Firebase Storage has not been set up on project' — which reads as the rules never having been deployed rather than as the CLI looking in the wrong place. They had been deployed. Change this when the project changes.
